correctness.rationale: Stationary renewal construction gives a post-event affine contraction. E[e^{-bA}]=(1-E e^{-bL})/(b mu) yields the exact uptake-positive time mean and a positive Jensen gap. For zero uptake the stationary mass equals a(A+S), with independent completed-interval sum S. Stationary age stochastically dominates uniform [0,mu], and independent-S Jensen implies every increasing convex loss inequality. Equality iff deterministic follows from strict exponential Jensen for positive uptake and positive interarrival variance or infinite mean for zero uptake. The finite-gap and crossed-CDF example uses events with strictly positive probability. Exact rational and SymPy symbolic checks replay from CHECK.py; finite checks are corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: For the salt-deposition/leaching model motivated by Suweis et al. (2010) and Mau et al. (2014), fixed average rainfall/leaching frequency does not determine environmental salt burden. The theorem quantifies precisely the preventable stationary-mean salt penalty of irregular leaching for every linear uptake rate; without uptake it simultaneously orders all nondecreasing convex damage functions. The explicit counterexample prevents the practically important mistaken extrapolation to every threshold exceedance probability. These structural all-renewal comparisons are not merely a calculation for one arbitrary parameter slice. Relevance is to the mathematical fixed-retention idealization; no irrigation-budget or crop-yield effectiveness claimed.
